title: [Bug]: WebDAV backup to NJU Box (Seafile) returns 401 in v1.8.3 while restore works with the same credentials
body:
### Issue Checklist

- [x] I understand that issues are for feedback and problem solving, not for complaining in the comment section, and will provide as much information as possible to help solve the problem.
- [x] My issue is not listed in the [FAQ](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues/3881).
- [x] I've looked at **pinned issues** and searched for existing [Open Issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues), [Closed Issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aclosed), and [Discussions](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/discussions), but did not find an open issue matching this exact behavior.
- [x] I've filled in short, clear headings so that developers can quickly identify the problem.
- [x] I've confirmed that I am using the latest version of Cherry Studio.

### Platform

Windows 11

### Version

v1.8.3

### Bug Description

When using WebDAV with **NJU Box** (`https://box.nju.edu.cn/seafdav`, Seafile-based), **restore works but backup fails** with the same credentials.

I reset the NJU Box WebDAV password, then Cherry Studio was able to **restore data successfully** from the WebDAV server. However, when I immediately try to **back up** to the same WebDAV target, Cherry Studio fails with:

```shell
Error invoking remote method 'backup:backupToWebdav': Error: Invalid response: 401 Not Authorized
```

Because restore succeeds first, the URL / username / password are already confirmed to be valid. The failure appears to be specific to the **write path** used by backup.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Configure WebDAV in Cherry Studio with NJU Box:
   - URL: `https://box.nju.edu.cn/seafdav`
   - Username format: `student_id@nju.edu.cn`
   - Password: dedicated NJU Box WebDAV password
2. Use Cherry Studio to **restore** data from this WebDAV target.
3. Confirm that restore succeeds.
4. Without changing credentials, try to **back up** data to the same WebDAV target.
5. Observe `401 Not Authorized` during backup.

### Expected Behavior

If restore can authenticate successfully with a WebDAV target, backup should also work with the same credentials.

### Relevant Log Output

```shell
[WebdavAutoSync] 2026/3/26 13:44:29 Error invoking remote method 'backup:backupToWebdav': Error: Invalid response: 401 Not Authorized
```

### Additional Context

- NJU Box is **Seafile-based** WebDAV.
- This looks related to older closed reports such as #895 and #2440, but the problem is still reproducible on **v1.8.3** in this specific scenario.
- Since **restore succeeds but backup fails**, this may indicate that the read flow (`PROPFIND` / `GET`) and write flow (`PUT` / `MKCOL`) are handling authentication differently for Seafile-based WebDAV servers.
- In other words, this may be a remaining compatibility issue in Cherry Studio's WebDAV client when writing to Seafile/NJU Box, even though reading from the same target works.

If needed, I can provide more reproduction details for the NJU Box setup.

title: [Feature]: Bundle git, node, uv runtimes into installer to eliminate environment dependency issues
body:
### Issue Checklist

- [x] I understand that issues are for reporting problems and requesting features, not for off-topic comments, and I will provide as much detail as possible to help resolve the issue.
- [x] I have checked the pinned issues and searched through the existing [open issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues), [closed issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aclosed), and [discussions](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/discussions) and did not find a similar suggestion.
- [x] I have provided a short and descriptive title so that developers can quickly understand the issue when browsing the issue list, rather than vague titles like "A suggestion" or "Stuck."
- [x] The latest version of Cherry Studio does not include the feature I am suggesting.

### Platform

All

### Version

v1.8.2

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

Many users (especially non-developers) lack pre-installed git, node, or uv, causing MCP server installation failures, OpenClaw dependency errors, and broken functionality:

- **git**: macOS `/usr/bin/git` is an Xcode CLT shim — `checkGitAvailable()` passes but `git` actually fails when CLT is not installed (#13358)
- **node**: No system node means `npx` is unavailable; current bun fallback has compatibility issues
- **uv**: Current auto-download on startup frequently fails in weak-network/offline environments, and repeatedly prompts users to install even after successful download (#3468)

Related issues:
- #12855 — Runtime management (unified runtime management request)
- #13358 — OpenClaw install fails due to git dependency (Xcode CLT shim)
- #3468 — MCP repeatedly asks to install uv and bun
- #3443 — Should reuse system-installed uv/bun
- #4018 — MCP can't find custom-installed bun/uv
- #13333 — OpenClaw installation fails for nvm/Homebrew users
- #13668 — Skill installation fails in no-proxy environment

### Desired Solution

Bundle git, node, and uv portable binaries directly into the Cherry Studio installer package (DMG / EXE / AppImage), so all tools are available immediately after installation with zero network dependency.

**Strategy:**

1. **Build-time packaging**: Include platform-specific portable binaries in `resources/bundled/` via electron-builder's `extraResources`
2. **First-launch extraction**: On first startup, extract bundled tools to `~/.cherrystudio/bin/` (~2s one-time operation)
3. **System-first priority**: If the user already has a working system git/node/uv (correct version), use the system version — don't override
4. **Enhanced detection**: Deep-check tool availability by actually executing `--version` (catches macOS Xcode CLT shim), with minimum version requirements (git ≥ 2.0, node ≥ 18)
5. **Deprecate uv download**: Remove `install-uv.js` runtime download script and related UI prompts

**Per-platform packaging:**

| Platform | git | node | uv | Installer size increase |
|----------|-----|------|----|------------------------|
| macOS arm64 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ~100MB |
| macOS x64 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ~100MB |
| Windows x64 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ~100MB |
| Linux x64/arm64 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ~100MB |

**Detection & fallback chain:**

```
System PATH has working tool (version OK)
  → Use system version ✅

System tool missing / too old / shim broken
  → Use ~/.cherrystudio/bin/ bundled version ✅
```

**MCPService npx fallback update:**

```
Current: npx → bun x (bun may not be downloaded)
New:     npx → ~/.cherrystudio/bin/npx → bun x
```

### Alternative Solutions

Keep the current auto-download approach but improve reliability with:
- Better mirror fallback (gitcode → GitHub → npm registry)
- Download resume/retry with progress UI
- Cache downloaded binaries across app updates

This was rejected because it still depends on network availability and doesn't solve the fundamental problem for offline/intranet users.

### Additional Information

**Full PRD available at:** `Cherry Studio PRDs/bundle-runtimes/PRD.md`

**Key technical references:**
- `src/main/utils/process.ts` — `checkGitAvailable()` (line 525)
- `resources/scripts/install-uv.js` — Current uv download script (to be deprecated)
- `src/main/utils/shell-env.ts` — PATH management
- `src/main/services/MCPService.ts` — npx fallback chain (line 407)
- `electron-builder.yml` — extraResources config

**Success criteria:**
- Fresh install users can use MCP servers and OpenClaw without installing any dev tools
- macOS users no longer blocked by Xcode CLT installation
- No more "please install uv" repeated prompts
- Offline/intranet users have full functionality after install

title: [Feature]: Support ASR (speech-to-text) and TTS (text-to-speech) via plugin system
body:
### Issue Checklist

- [x] I understand that issues are for reporting problems and requesting features, not for off-topic comments, and I will provide as much detail as possible to help resolve the issue.
- [x] I have checked the pinned issues and searched through the existing [open issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues), [closed issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aclosed), and [discussions](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/discussions) and did not find a similar suggestion.

- [x] The latest version of Cherry Studio does not include the feature I am suggesting.

### Platform

All

### Version

v1.8.2+

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

This has been one of the most requested features since the earliest days of Cherry Studio, with at least 8 related issues:

| Issue | Title | Status |
|-------|-------|--------|
| #41 | Voice input/output | closed |
| #6399 | ASR | closed |
| #6394 | TTS | closed |
| #9406 | Add ASR feature | closed |
| #12050 | Conversational Voice Mode | closed |
| #11645 | TTS feature | closed |
| #13341 | Speech-to-text feature request | **open** |
| #13204 | TTS for Selection Assistant | **open** |

Previous issues were closed because there was no plugin system to support extensible ASR/TTS backends. Now that the plugin system (#13391) is being built, this becomes feasible.

**Prerequisite:** #13391 (Plugin system must be completed first)

### Desired Solution

Add ASR (speech-to-text) and TTS (text-to-speech) capabilities via the plugin system.

#### ASR — Voice Input

- New **microphone button** in Inputbar (alongside attachment button)
- Click to start recording → click again to stop → audio sent to ASR plugin → transcribed text fills into input box
- Recording UI: button turns red with pulse animation + real-time duration display
- Cancel with Esc key, auto-stop at 5 minutes
- If no ASR plugin installed, prompt user to install one

#### TTS — Text-to-Speech

- New **"Read aloud" button** in message action bar (alongside copy, translate)
- New **"Read aloud" button** in Selection Assistant toolbar
- Long text (>500 chars) auto-segmented for streaming playback
- Smart filtering: skip code blocks and LaTeX formulas
- Playback control: stop button during playback
- If no TTS plugin installed, prompt user to install one

#### Plugin-based Architecture

- Core code only handles **UI + IPC bridging** — no ASR/TTS logic in core
- ASR/TTS backends provided entirely by plugins (e.g., OpenAI Whisper, Azure Speech, Edge TTS, local whisper.cpp)
- Users install only what they need — no core package size increase
- Community can contribute new ASR/TTS providers

#### Data Flow

```
ASR: User speech → MediaRecorder → IPC(asr:transcribe) → ASR Plugin → Text → Inputbar
TTS: Message text → Strip markdown/code → IPC(tts:synthesize) → TTS Plugin → Audio → Web Audio API playback
```

### Alternative Solutions

- Built-in ASR/TTS without plugin system — rejected because backends are too diverse (cloud APIs, local models, different providers)
- Web Speech API — limited browser support, no model choice, poor CJK accuracy

### Additional Information

Full PRD with technical design, component architecture, type definitions, and test specs is available.

Key technical points:
- ASR uses `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia()` + `MediaRecorder` API (natively supported by Electron's Chromium)
- TTS playback via Web Audio API (`AudioContext`)
- macOS microphone permission via `systemPreferences.askForMediaAccess('microphone')`
- New IPC channels: `asr:transcribe`, `tts:synthesize`, `speech:list-plugins`
- New Inputbar tool: `voiceInputTool` following existing `defineTool()` pattern
- New hooks: `useAudioRecorder`, `useTTSPlayback`

title: [Feature]: Unify Agent types and add built-in Agent role system (Cherry Assistant + Skill Creator)
body:
### Issue Checklist

- [x] I understand that issues are for reporting problems and requesting features, not for off-topic comments, and I will provide as much detail as possible to help resolve the issue.
- [x] I have checked the pinned issues and searched through the existing open issues, closed issues, and discussions and did not find a similar suggestion.
- [x] I have provided a short and descriptive title so that developers can quickly understand the issue when browsing the issue list, rather than vague titles like "A suggestion" or "Stuck."
- [x] The latest version of Cherry Studio does not include the feature I am suggesting.

### Platform

macOS

### Version

v1.7.24 (dev)

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

Currently, the Agent system has three separate types (`claude-code`, `cherry-claw`, `cherry-assistant`) with different service implementations and capabilities. This creates unnecessary complexity:

- Users must choose an agent type when creating agents, but the distinction is confusing
- CherryClaw capabilities (channels, scheduled tasks, heartbeat, soul prompt) are locked to one type
- Built-in agents (Cherry Assistant) are implemented as entirely separate types rather than pre-configured agents
- Adding new built-in agents requires adding new types, new services, new UI branches

### Desired Solution

**Unify all agents into a single type with a built-in role system:**

1. **Single Agent Type** — Remove agent type selection. All agents are `'agent'` type with unified capabilities (formerly CherryClaw-only: channels, scheduler, heartbeat, soul prompt from workspace files).

2. **Built-in Role System** — Identify built-in agents via `configuration.builtin_role` field instead of separate types:
   - `'assistant'` — Cherry Assistant: in-app support, navigation, FAQ, issue reporting
   - `'skill-creator'` — Skill Creator: create, discover, and manage Agent Skills

3. **Unified Agent Service** — Replace separate `CherryClawService` + `CherryAssistantService` with a single `UnifiedAgentService` that:
   - Applies base capabilities (claw MCP, soul prompt) for ALL agents
   - Injects role-specific customizations (custom prompt, MCP servers) based on `builtin_role`
   - Delegates to `ClaudeCodeService` for SDK invocation

4. **New Built-in Agent: Skill Creator** — Pre-configured agent for creating, discovering, installing, and managing Skills through natural conversation.

5. **Simplified UI** — No type selector when creating agents. All agents get full settings (Channels, Tasks, Permission Mode, Tools & MCP). Built-in agents get a simplified settings menu.

### Alternative Solutions

Keep the current multi-type architecture but add `skill-creator` as a fourth type. This was rejected because it increases complexity rather than reducing it, and the type distinction doesn't provide meaningful value to users.

### Additional Information

**Key architectural changes:**

| Component | Before | After |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| `AgentType` | `'claude-code' \| 'cherry-claw' \| 'cherry-assistant'` | `'agent'` (+ legacy values for backward compat) |
| Service dispatch | 3 separate services | 1 `UnifiedAgentService` + base `ClaudeCodeService` |
| Built-in detection | By `agent.type` | By `configuration.builtin_role` |
| Agent capabilities | Type-gated (CherryClaw only) | All agents get full capabilities |
| UI type selector | Required on creation | Removed |
| Settings menu | Type-specific tabs | Role-based (built-in: simplified, regular: full) |
| Channel/scheduler logic | `type === 'cherry-claw'` checks | Configuration-based checks |

**Files changed:**
- `src/renderer/src/types/agent.ts` — Added `BuiltinRoleSchema`, expanded `AgentTypeSchema`
- `src/main/services/agents/services/unified/index.ts` — New unified service
- `src/main/services/agents/services/skillcreator/prompt.ts` — Skill Creator system prompt
- `src/main/services/agents/services/AgentService.ts` — Built-in agent creation logic
- `src/main/services/agents/BaseService.ts` — All agents get builtin tools/commands
- `src/main/services/agents/services/channels/ChannelManager.ts` — Config-based channel detection
- `src/main/apiServer/routes/agents/handlers/agents.ts` — Config-based scheduler/heartbeat
- `src/renderer/src/components/Popups/agent/AgentModal.tsx` — Removed type selector
- `src/renderer/src/pages/settings/AgentSettings/AgentSettingsPopup.tsx` — Role-based menus

**Backward compatibility:** Existing DB records with legacy types (`cherry-claw`, `cherry-assistant`, `claude-code`) are fully supported — all route to the unified service.

body:

- [x] I have checked the pinned issues and searched through the existing [open issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues), [closed issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aclosed), and [discussions](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/discussions) and did not find a similar suggestion.

- [x] The latest version of Cherry Studio does not include the feature I am suggesting.

### Platform

Windows

### Version

1.8.3

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

First of all, this is a great LLM-UI and thank you. The issue is, the context gets clogged up with MCP tools if many are present. I suggest a dynamic tool loading like in Claude Desktop. In free tiers, the TPM is low and this leads to usability issues if all or higher number of tools are loaded into context. Now I understand that the `@cherry/hub: list` does limit, but I think it can be more optimized.

### Desired Solution

A two-phase tool loading system that keeps the model's context small while still allowing access to tools.

1. Client gathers all tools from connected MCP servers.
2. It loads a few tools based on frequent usage or FIFO to save prompt space.
3. A default `tool_search` tool is always visible to the model, which can be BM25/regex search
4. Model starts with a minimal set of tools.
5. When it needs something missing, it calls the search tool.
6. The `tool_search` finds relevant tools and injects them into model's context dynamically.

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

Related to #13831.

While attempting to fix the issue where `effort` was not correctly converted to `thinking_budget`, I discovered that the current `effort → thinking_budget` mapping strategy itself is fundamentally flawed for certain models.

**Experiment**: Using Qwen3.5-397B-A17B with `low` effort, `thinking_budget` was correctly converted to 4096 tokens. However, this actually made the model **overthink significantly more** compared to not passing `thinking_budget` at all:

| Scenario | Prompt | Thinking Time |
|---|---|---|
| No `thinking_budget` (default) | "Hi" | ~11s |
| `thinking_budget: 4096` (low effort) | "Hi" | ~49s |

This reveals that the model tends to **exhaust** whatever thinking budget it receives, regardless of the actual complexity of the prompt. Even 4096 tokens (which is only ~5% of Qwen3.5's ~80k max thinking budget) is far too much for a trivial prompt like "Hi" — a budget of 100 would already be excessive in this case.

### Desired Solution

We need a more nuanced approach to `effort → thinking_budget` mapping that accounts for model-specific behavior differences. Some potential directions:

1. **Model-family-specific scaling**: Different model families (Qwen, Claude, Gemini, etc.) may need fundamentally different mapping curves. Qwen3.5 clearly needs much more aggressive reduction at lower effort levels compared to Claude models.

2. **Non-linear mapping**: Instead of the current linear interpolation between `min` and `max`, consider exponential or logarithmic curves that provide finer granularity at the lower end.

3. **Provider-level overrides**: Allow `THINKING_TOKEN_MAP` entries to optionally specify custom effort ratios or mapping functions per model family.

4. **Consider not sending `thinking_budget` at low effort**: For models that behave better without an explicit thinking budget, the "low" effort setting could simply omit the parameter rather than sending a small value that paradoxically increases thinking.

The ideal solution would be for models to dynamically decide thinking intensity based on prompt complexity, but since that's a model-level behavior we can't control from the client side, we need smarter client-side heuristics.

### Alternative Solutions

- **Per-model opt-out**: Add a flag in model configuration to disable `thinking_budget` passthrough entirely, letting the model use its default behavior.
- **User-configurable thinking budget**: Expose the raw `thinking_budget` value as an advanced setting, allowing power users to fine-tune it manually.
- **Adaptive approach**: Start with a very low budget and increase it if the model indicates truncated reasoning (though this would require multiple API calls).

### Additional Information

The current `EFFORT_RATIO` mapping:
- `minimal`: 0.01
- `low`: 0.05
- `medium`: 0.5
- `high`: 0.95
- `xhigh`: 1.0

For Qwen3.5 with a max of ~80k tokens, even `minimal` (0.01) would yield ~800 tokens, which may still cause overthinking for simple prompts. The root issue is that some models interpret any explicit thinking budget as a signal to think **at least** that much, rather than treating it as a maximum.

Code reference: `src/renderer/src/aiCore/utils/reasoning.ts` — `getReasoningEffort()` and the `EFFORT_RATIO` / `findTokenLimit()` mechanisms.

N/A (codebase improvement)

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

Currently the TypeScript compiler option `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` is not enabled. This means array/object index access returns `T` instead of `T | undefined`, which can lead to silent runtime errors when accessing out-of-bounds indices or missing keys.

### Desired Solution

Enable `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true` in both `tsconfig.node.json` and `tsconfig.web.json`, and fix all resulting type errors across the codebase.

This is a large change (~922 errors across ~255 files), so it will be done in phases:

- [ ] Add `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true` to `tsconfig.node.json` and `tsconfig.web.json`
- [ ] Fix all `[node]` typecheck errors (~235 errors)
- [ ] Fix all `[web]` typecheck errors (~687 errors)
- [ ] Verify `pnpm typecheck` passes cleanly

### Alternative Solutions

_No response_

### Additional Information

This change improves type safety by forcing explicit null checks when accessing array elements or object properties by index, preventing potential `undefined` runtime errors.

### Platform

Windows

### Version

main

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

Cherry Studio supports a wide range of provider API formats, but the user experience feels somewhat confusing. From this perspective, there are currently four obvious categories of providers:

1. CherryIN. A special New API provider.
2. New API providers. Supports per-model endpoints.
3. Other System providers. Does not support switching `type`.
4. Custom providers. Can switch `type`.

`provider.type` itself is not entirely an API format, but rather a mix of multiple meanings. Besides `provider.type`, `anthropicApiHost` is also maintained specifically to support the Anthropic API format.

This design has some issues. For example: a system provider's `type` is hardcoded, even if it supports multiple API formats. Users can only create a new custom provider, which is quite troublesome.

Therefore, consider establishing a clearer, more maintainable API format configuration hierarchy that also provides users with greater freedom.

### Desired Solution

The current `Provider` definition in the code is as follows:

```ts
export type Provider = {
  id: string
  type: ProviderType
  name: string
  apiKey: string
  apiHost: string
  anthropicApiHost?: string
  isAnthropicModel?: (m: Model) => boolean
  apiVersion?: string
  models: Model[]
  enabled?: boolean
  isSystem?: boolean
  isAuthed?: boolean
  rateLimit?: number

  apiOptions?: ProviderApiOptions
  serviceTier?: ServiceTier
  verbosity?: OpenAIVerbosity

  isNotSupportArrayContent?: boolean
  isNotSupportStreamOptions?: boolean
  isNotSupportDeveloperRole?: boolean
  isNotSupportServiceTier?: boolean

  authType?: 'apiKey' | 'oauth'
  isVertex?: boolean
  notes?: string
  extra_headers?: Record<string, string>

  anthropicCacheControl?: AnthropicCacheControlSettings
}
```

The new `Provider` type and related types are approximately as follows:

```ts
type ApiFormat =
  | 'openai'
  | 'openai-response'
  | 'anthropic'
  | 'gemini'

type ProviderFormatCompatibility = {
  array_content?: boolean
  stream_options?: boolean
  developer_role?: boolean
  service_tier?: boolean
  enable_thinking?: boolean
  verbosity?: boolean
}

type ProviderFormatConfigBase = {
  base_url: string
  api_version?: string
  extra_headers?: Record<string, string>
  compatibility?: ProviderFormatCompatibility
  service_tier?: ServiceTier
}

type AnthropicFormatConfig = ProviderFormatConfigBase & {
  cache_control?: AnthropicCacheControlSettings
}

type ProviderFormats = Partial<{
  openai: ProviderFormatConfigBase
  'openai-response': ProviderFormatConfigBase
  anthropic: AnthropicFormatConfig
  gemini: ProviderFormatConfigBase
}>

type Provider = {
  id: string
  type: ProviderType
  name: string

  available_api_formats: ApiFormat[]
  api_format: ApiFormat
  formats: ProviderFormats

  apiKey: string
  authType?: 'apiKey' | 'oauth'

  models: Model[]
  enabled?: boolean
  isSystem?: boolean
  isAuthed?: boolean
  rateLimit?: number
  verbosity?: OpenAIVerbosity
  isVertex?: boolean
  notes?: string
}
```

Constraints:

- `provider.api_format` must be included in `provider.available_api_formats`.
- Keys in `provider.formats` must be a subset of `provider.available_api_formats`.
- `provider.api_format` must have a valid configuration in `provider.formats`.
- An API format is only considered available at runtime when both conditions are met: it appears in `provider.available_api_formats` AND has a valid configuration in `provider.formats`.

The `Provider` type field migration table is as follows:

| Old Field | Destination | New Field | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | Keep | | |
| `type` | Keep | | Recommended for representing access type, and recommend renaming. |
| `-` | New | `provider.api_format` | The API format currently used by default. |
| `name` | Keep | | |
| `apiKey` | Keep | | |
| `apiHost` | Migrate | `formats[api_format].base_url` | Each API format maintains its own base URL. |
| `anthropicApiHost` | Migrate | `formats.anthropic.base_url` | The top-level Anthropic host is no longer separately retained. |
| `isAnthropicModel` | deprecated |  |  |
| `apiVersion` | Migrate | `formats[api_format].api_version` | Version configuration belongs to specific API format. |
| `models` | Keep | | |
| `enabled` | Keep | | |
| `isSystem` | Keep | | |
| `isAuthed` | Keep | | |
| `rateLimit` | Keep | | |
| `apiOptions` | Migrate | `formats[api_format].compatibility` | Compatibility matrix for specific API format. |
| `serviceTier` | Migrate | `formats[api_format].service_tier` | Only effective in OpenAI/Groq style requests, should be a format-level parameter. |
| `verbosity` | Keep |  |  |
| `isNotSupportArrayContent` | deprecated |  |  |
| `isNotSupportStreamOptions` | deprecated |  |  |
| `isNotSupportDeveloperRole` | deprecated |  |  |
| `isNotSupportServiceTier` | deprecated |  |  |
| `authType` | Keep | | |
| `isVertex` | Keep |  | |
| `notes` | Keep | | |
| `extra_headers` | Migrate | `formats[api_format].extra_headers` | Transport overrides for current API format. |
| `anthropicCacheControl` | Migrate | `formats.anthropic.cache_control` | Anthropic-specific configuration. |

### Platform

Windows

### Version

1.8.4

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

NO

### Desired Solution

 propose adding a "Generation Complete Notification" feature with the following specifics:

Sound Alert: Play a subtle notification sound when the response generation finishes.
System Toast Notification: Display a native OS notification (e.g., Windows Action Center toast) indicating that the answer is ready, even if Cherry Studio is minimized or in the background. (Similar to how the "Trea" client handles notifications).
Settings Toggle: Add an option in the Settings menu to enable/disable this feature. It should be disabled by default to avoid disturbing users who do not need it, allowing users to opt-in if they prefer.

### Alternative Solutions

When using Cherry Studio for complex tasks, the AI model often enters "thinking mode" or requires a long time (e.g., 100+ seconds) to generate a response.

Current Pain Point:
During this waiting period, I often switch to other applications to work. Currently, Cherry Studio does not notify me when the generation is complete. I have to manually switch back to check if the response is ready, which leads to inefficiency and interrupts my workflow. There is no indication that the task has finished unless I am actively looking at the window.

### Additional Information

This feature is standard in many other AI clients and significantly improves productivity for long-running tasks. It allows users to manage their time better without needing to stare at the loading screen.

Summary of requirements:

✅ Sound notification
✅ System desktop notification
✅ Configurable in Settings (Default: Off)
Thank you for considering this enhancement!

title: [Discussion]: Bundled binary environment isolation strategy
body:
### Issue Checklist

- [x] I understand that issues are meant for feedback and problem-solving, not for venting, and I will provide as much detail as possible to help resolve the issue.
- [x] I have checked the pinned issues and searched through the existing [open issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues), [closed issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aclosed), and [discussions](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/discussions) and did not find a similar suggestion.
- [x] I confirm that I am here to ask questions and discuss issues, not to report bugs or request features.

### Platform

All (Windows, macOS, Linux)

### Version

Latest

### Your Question

Cherry Studio bundles and invokes several external binaries (`uv`, `bun`, `openclaw`, CLI tools like claude-code/gemini-cli), but there is **no defined isolation strategy** for their runtime environments. The current behavior is inconsistent across services, and there is no documented decision on whether these tools should share or be isolated from the user's global environment.

**Current state:**

| Service | Binary | Behavior |
|---------|--------|----------|
| CodeCliService | `bun install -g` | Sets `BUN_INSTALL=~/.cherrystudio/` — partially isolated |
| MCPService | `bun` (npx fallback) | No `BUN_INSTALL` set — uses user's global bun env |
| MCPService | `uv`, `uvx` | No `UV_TOOL_DIR`/`UV_CACHE_DIR` — writes to user's global `~/.local/share/uv/` |
| CodeCliService | `uv` (kimi-cli) | Same as above — no isolation |
| OpenClawService | `openclaw` | Pollutes user's existing configuration |
| CodeCliService | CLI tools (claude-code, gemini-cli, etc.) | Installed into `~/.cherrystudio/`, but runtime configs read from user-global locations (e.g., `~/.claude/settings.json`) — env vars from the user's own config get injected into Cherry Studio's invocation, causing conflicts (see #13924) |

**Real-world impact — #13924:**
When a user has `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` configured in their `~/.claude/settings.json` (for standalone Claude Code use), Cherry Studio's code tool invocation picks up that config and injects both `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` (from user config) and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` (from Cherry Studio), causing an auth conflict error. This is a direct consequence of lacking environment isolation.

**Key questions for the team:**

1. Should Cherry Studio's bundled tools operate in a fully isolated environment, share the user's global environment, or offer a choice?
2. If isolation is desired, should it apply uniformly to all tools, or are some tools expected to use their global config?
3. How should we handle the inconsistency between services (e.g., `CodeCliService` isolates bun but `MCPService` does not)?

### Context

Identified during review of #13923 (fix: resolve uv binary not found error when running kimi-cli).

The inconsistency is notable — `CodeCliService` already partially isolates bun via `BUN_INSTALL`, but this pattern was not extended to uv or other services. There is currently no centralized mechanism for scoping tool environments.

### Additional Information

Relevant environment variables for isolation:
- **uv**: `UV_TOOL_DIR`, `UV_CACHE_DIR`, `UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR`
- **bun**: `BUN_INSTALL`, `BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR`
- **openclaw**: needs investigation
- **CLI tools**: tool-specific config dirs (e.g., `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `CLAUDE_SETTINGS_DIR`)

Related issues:
- #13923 — fix: resolve uv binary not found error when running kimi-cli
- #13924 — AUTH_TOKEN set in `~/.claude/settings.json` conflicts with code tool settings

### Priority

Medium (Would like a response soon)

title: [Bug]: Agent task list shows last task still running after session completion
body:
## Bug Description
---
After an Agent session completes, the **last task in the task list remains in "running" state** (spinning indicator), even though the conversation has finished and the agent has returned a final response.

## Root cause analysis 
---
When the Agent SDK stream emits a `'complete'` event, the backend closes the stream without emitting `onToolCallComplete` for pending/streaming tool calls. The last tool block's `rawMcpToolResponse.status` stays at `'pending'` instead of transitioning to `'done'`, causing the UI spinner to continue indefinitely.

**Data Flow**:
```
Agent SDK stream → main process (claudecode/index.ts)
  → stream parts transformed (transform.ts)
    → renderer toolCallbacks (toolCallbacks.ts)
      → rawMcpToolResponse.status 写入 message block
        → ToolBlockGroup.tsx / GenericTools.tsx 读取 status 渲染 UI
``` 

**Affected code path**:
1. `src/main/services/agents/services/claudecode/index.ts` — stream completion handler (L395-416) does not finalize pending tasks
2. `src/main/services/agents/services/SessionMessageService.ts` — no cleanup logic for uncompleted tool blocks on session end
3. `src/renderer/src/services/messageStreaming/callbacks/toolCallbacks.ts` — `onToolCallComplete` is never called for the last task
4. `src/renderer/src/pages/home/Messages/Tools/MessageAgentTools/GenericTools.tsx` — renders spinning indicator for `'pending'` status

## Impact
---
Currently a cosmetic issue, but with the upcoming v2 UI redesign, the task list will be more prominent and this bug will become much more visible to users.

## Steps To Reproduce
---
1. Create an Agent with an Anthropic-type provider
2. Send a complex task that triggers **multiple tool calls** (e.g., "search for X and summarize the results")
3. Wait for the Agent to complete the entire conversation
4. Observe the task list on the left — the **last task** remains in running/spinning state
Already reproduced in both mac/windows, confirmed this issue exist.

## Expected Behavior
---
All tasks in the task list should show "completed" (checkmark) status after the Agent session finishes.

## Relevant Log Output
---
```shell
N/A — no errors in console; the issue is that the final status update event is never emitted.
```

## Suggested fix
---
When the Agent session stream completes (`'complete'` or `'cancelled'` event), iterate over all tool blocks with `status !== 'done'` and set them to `'done'` (or `'cancelled'`). 
This can be done in either:
- Backend: `SessionMessageService.ts` — emit final tool status on stream close
- Frontend: `AgentMessageDataSource.ts` — clean up pending tool blocks when session ends

title: [Feature]: Harden preload bridge shell.openExternal and deduplicate URL allowlist (follow-up to #13892)
body:
### Issue Checklist

- [x] I understand that issues are for reporting problems and requesting features, not for off-topic comments, and I will provide as much detail as possible to help resolve the issue.
- [x] I have checked the pinned issues and searched through the existing open issues, closed issues, and discussions and did not find a similar suggestion.
- [x] I have provided a short and descriptive title so that developers can quickly understand the issue when browsing the issue list, rather than vague titles like "A suggestion" or "Stuck."
- [x] The latest version of Cherry Studio does not include the feature I am suggesting.

### Platform

Windows, macOS, Linux

### Version

All versions

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

This is a follow-up to #13892, which added `isSafeExternalUrl()` validation to 4 `shell.openExternal()` call sites in the main process and fixed a path traversal vulnerability in the `http://file/` handler.

During review, several hardening gaps were identified that should be addressed in a follow-up:

1. **Preload bridge bypass**: `src/preload/index.ts` exposes `shell.openExternal` directly to the renderer process without any protocol validation. Renderer code calling `window.api.shell.openExternal()` completely bypasses the security checks added in #13892.

2. **Existing legitimate non-standard protocol usage** that will break when preload validation is added:
   - `src/renderer/src/components/CodeBlockView/HtmlArtifactsCard.tsx` — uses `file://` to open HTML artifacts in external browser
   - `src/renderer/src/pages/settings/SelectionAssistantSettings/components/MacProcessTrustHintModal.tsx` — uses `x-apple.systempreferences:` to open macOS Accessibility settings

3. **Duplicated allowlist**: `ALLOWED_PROTOCOLS` in `preload/index.ts` and `ALLOWED_EXTERNAL_PROTOCOLS` in `security.ts` are hardcoded copies of the same list, requiring manual sync on updates.

4. **Missing type-level constraints**: No compile-time enforcement on URL protocols passed through IPC — runtime validation is the only defense.

5. **Missing path traversal unit tests**: The `http://file/` handler logic in `WindowService.ts` lacks dedicated unit tests for path traversal scenarios.

### Desired Solution

1. **Harden preload bridge**: Add `isSafeExternalUrl()` validation in `src/preload/index.ts`, or redirect `window.api.shell.openExternal()` to use the already-validated `IpcChannel.Open_Website` IPC channel.

2. **Design a flexible allowlist** that accommodates legitimate non-standard protocols:
   - Option A: Extend the allowlist with `file:` and `x-apple.systempreferences:` (simpler but broader)
   - Option B: Provide an options parameter like `isSafeExternalUrl(url, { allowFile: true })` for call-site-specific overrides
   - Option C: Create dedicated IPC channels for `file://` and system-preferences URLs, keeping the general allowlist strict

3. **Deduplicate the allowlist**: Export `ALLOWED_EXTERNAL_PROTOCOLS` from `security.ts` and reuse it in preload, or share via `@shared`.

4. **Add template literal type constraints** for IPC parameters:
   ```typescript
   type SafeExternalUrl = `http://${string}` | `https://${string}` | `mailto:${string}`
   ```

5. **Add unit tests** for the `http://file/` path traversal prevention logic in `WindowService.ts`.

### Alternative Solutions

- Instead of hardening the preload bridge, remove `shell.openExternal` from the preload API entirely and force all external URL opening through validated IPC channels. This is more restrictive but eliminates the bypass surface completely.

### Additional Information

Related PR review discussions:
- @GeorgeDong32's review identifying the preload bypass and missing tests
- @EurFelux's review identifying the type constraint opportunity and existing functionality compatibility concerns

## Branch Strategy Update

**Updated**: May 29, 2026

The `v2` branch has been merged into `main`. The previous April 3, 2026 policy that directed new feature work to `v2` is no longer current.

### Current Branch Strategy

- **`main` branch**: Default branch for active development. New features, refactors, optimizations, and fixes for the current codebase should target `main`.
- **`v1` branch**: Maintenance branch for Cherry Studio v1 hotfixes and subsequent v1 releases.

### Pull Request Guidance

- New PRs for active development should target `main`.
- All hotfix PRs for v1 releases must target the `v1` branch.
- Changes merged into `v1` are not automatically carried over to `main`. If the bug fixed by a v1 hotfix also exists on `main`, submit a separate forward-port PR targeting `main`.

### Platform

Windows

### Version

v1.8.4

### Bug Description

In the overview page of Cherry Studio's built-in OpenClaw plugin, the language setting dropdown can be changed from English to Simplified Chinese, but there is no save button after switching. Once you navigate away from this page (e.g., switch to other settings or restart Cherry Studio), returning to the overview page causes the language setting to automatically revert to English.

### Steps To Reproduce

**Reproduction Steps**

1. Open Cherry Studio and ensure OpenClaw is installed and started.
2. Go to the Overview page of the OpenClaw plugin.
3. Find the Language dropdown menu.
4. Change the language from English to Simplified Chinese.
5. Switch to another page (e.g., model settings), then switch back to the overview page.
6. Observe whether the language setting reverts to English (expected to remain as Simplified Chinese).

**Tried Temporary Solutions (All Ineffective)**

- Manually modifying configuration file: Adding "language": "zh-Hans" in ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json still shows English interface after restarting the Gateway.
- Setting environment variable: Adding OPENCLAW_LANGUAGE=zh-Hans remains ineffective after restart.
- URL temporary parameter: Adding ?lang=zh-Hans to the Gateway Web console URL only temporarily switches the current page and cannot persist.
- Adjusting Cherry Studio main program language: Setting Cherry Studio's main program language to Simplified Chinese and restarting, the OpenClaw plugin interface still displays in English.
- Clearing cache and reinstalling OpenClaw: Deleting the C:\Users\Username\.cherrystudio\openclaw plugin cache directory and reinstalling OpenClaw in Cherry Studio, the problem persists.

### Expected Behavior

The language setting should take effect immediately and persist after switching, without resetting due to page switching or software restart. It is recommended to provide a clear save button or automatically save the state when switching languages.

title: [Feature]: aiCore Audio/Video Capability Completion + AI SDK v6 New Feature Adoption + Provider Bug Fixes
body:
> [!NOTE]
> This issue/comment/review was translated by Claude.

### Issue Checklist

- [x] I understand that issues are for reporting problems and requesting features, not for off-topic comments, and I will provide as much detail as possible to help resolve the issue.
- [x] I have checked the pinned issues and searched through the existing open issues, closed issues, and discussions and did not find a similar suggestion.
- [x] I have provided a short and descriptive title so that developers can quickly understand the issue when browsing the issue list.
- [x] The latest version of Cherry Studio does not include the feature I am suggesting.

### Platform

macOS

### Version

v2.0.0-alpha

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

AI SDK v6 has provided complete audio/video/speech APIs (`generateSpeech`, `generateTranscription`, `generateVideo`), but the aiCore layer currently only implements `generateText`/`streamText`/`generateImage`/`editImage`/`embedMany`, **audio/video capabilities are completely missing**.

Additionally, there are the following new AI SDK v6 features that have not been adopted, as well as known defects in the provider layer that need to be fixed.

### Desired Solution

## I. Audio/Video Capability Completion

### P0 — Audio/Video Files as LLM Input

- [x] **`fileProcessor.ts` supports audio file input**: Convert `.mp3/.wav/.ogg/.flac/.aac` to `AudioPart`/`FilePart` and send to models (Gemini 2.0, GPT-4o already support audio understanding)
- [ ] **`fileProcessor.ts` supports video file input**: Convert `.mp4/.mov/.mkv` etc. to `FilePart` and send to models (Gemini 2.0 already supports video understanding)

### P1 — TTS / STT Execution Pipeline

- [ ] **Executor adds `generateSpeech()`**: Connect existing CherryIn/AiHubMix `speechModel()` → OpenAI TTS
- [ ] **Executor adds `generateTranscription()`**: Connect CherryIn `transcriptionModel()` → OpenAI Whisper
- [ ] **AiProvider exposes `generateSpeech()` / `generateTranscription()` methods**
- [ ] **Remove TTS/Whisper filtering from `NOT_SUPPORTED_REGEX`** (`/(?:^tts|whisper|speech)/i`), so users can see these models in the model selector
- [ ] **Connect audio streaming Chunk pipeline**: `AUDIO_START` / `AUDIO_DELTA` / `AUDIO_COMPLETE` types are already defined, need to actually use them in streaming callbacks

### P2 — Video Generation

- [ ] **Executor adds `generateVideo()`**: Integrate with Google Veo (`@ai-sdk/google` v3.0.55 already includes `generateVideos`)
- [ ] **Connect `VideoBlock` / `videoCallbacks`**: Types and callback framework are already defined but not integrated

---

## II. AI SDK v6 New Feature Adoption

### P0 — Deprecated API Migration

- [x] **`searchOrchestrationPlugin.ts` `generateObject` → `generateText` + `Output.object()`** (`generateObject` is deprecated in v6)

### P1 — Provider Capability Enhancement

- [x] **Adopt Provider-Executed Tools**: Let provider-side execute tools (e.g., OpenAI built-in tools), not limited to client-side only
- [ ] **Configure Anthropic `structuredOutputMode`**: Enable Claude Sonnet 4.5+ native structured output (`'outputFormat'` / `'jsonTool'` / `'auto'`)
- [x] **Enable `smoothStream` reasoning support**: Smooth output for reasoning tokens

### P2 — New API Adoption

- [x] **Evaluate `ToolLoopAgent` framework**: `src/main/services/agents/` can consider adopting AI SDK's stable Agent system
- [ ] **`Output.choice()` for classification scenarios**
- [x] **Reranking API**: Voyage AI provider already registered, can integrate experimental rerank
- [x] **Tool Execution Approval (`needsApproval`)**

---

## III. Provider Layer Known Defect Fixes

### Bug / FIXME

- [x] **Qwen3 thinking control failure** (`parameterBuilder.ts:123`): FIXME — Qwen3 still enables thinking even when disabled, does not support `/no_think` soft switch
- [x] **OpenRouter reasoning detection logic duplication** (`utils/reasoning.ts:399`): FIXME — Duplicate openrouter logic needs to be merged
- [x] **GitHub Copilot ProviderV3 incomplete** (`extensions/index.ts:81-82`): Forced `as unknown as ProviderV3` type casting

### Architecture Improvements

- [x] **Type separation** (`types/index.ts:7`): TODO — renderer/main/shared types not separated
- [x] **Extension config immutable** (`initialization.ts:190`): OpenRouter cannot modify config after registration
- [x] **Azure Claude routing workaround** (`providerConfig.ts:240-241`): Claude models need to route to `google-vertex-anthropic`

### Feature Completion

- [x] **PDF compatibility configurable** (`pdfCompatibilityPlugin.ts:49`): TODO — Allow users to configure provider/model-level native PDF compatibility
- [ ] **New-API reasoning detection** (`utils/reasoning.ts:353`): TODO — Does not support new-api endpoint type
- [ ] **Migrate to `@ai-sdk/open-responses`** (`utils/options.ts:339`): TODO — Remove workaround (#13462)
- [x] **MCP media format provider-aware selection** (`utils/mcp.ts:186`)

### Alternative Solutions

- Audio input: Can consider using Web Audio API in renderer for format conversion first, then send to supported models
- TTS: Can start by integrating only OpenAI TTS-1 as MVP, expand to more providers later
- Video generation: Google Veo is still experimental API, can be introduced as experimental feature flag

### Additional Information

**Infrastructure that exists but is not connected:**
- Audio streaming Chunk types already defined: `AudioStartChunk`, `AudioDeltaChunk`, `AudioCompleteChunk`
- Video message blocks already defined: `VideoBlock` / `VideoMessageBlock` (with `url` and `filePath`)
- Video callback framework already exists: `onVideoSearched` in `videoCallbacks.ts`
- Speech error types already defined: `SerializedAiSdkNoSpeechGeneratedError`
- CherryIn provider already has `speechModel()` and `transcriptionModel()` methods
- AiHubMix provider already has `speechModel()` method

**Current AI SDK version:** `ai@^6.0.143`, all `@ai-sdk/*` provider packages are already in v3.x/v4.x (v6 compatible versions)

**Reference documentation:** [AI SDK v6 Migration Guide](https://sdk.vercel.ai/docs/migration-guide/v6)

此外，还有以下 AI SDK v6 新功能未被采用，以及 provider 层已知缺陷需要修复。

### Desired Solution

## 一、音视频能力补全

### P0 — 音视频文件作为 LLM 输入

- [ ] **`fileProcessor.ts` 支持音频文件输入**：将 `.mp3/.wav/.ogg/.flac/.aac` 转为 `AudioPart`/`FilePart` 发送给模型（Gemini 2.0、GPT-4o 已支持音频理解）

- [ ] **Executor 新增 `generateSpeech()`**：连通已有的 CherryIn/AiHubMix `speechModel()` → OpenAI TTS
- [ ] **Executor 新增 `generateTranscription()`**：连通 CherryIn `transcriptionModel()` → OpenAI Whisper

- [ ] **连通 `VideoBlock` / `videoCallbacks`**：类型和回调框架已定义但未集成

- [ ] **`searchOrchestrationPlugin.ts` 中的 `generateObject` → `generateText` + `Output.object()`**（`generateObject` 在 v6 已废弃）

### P1 — Provider 能力增强

- [ ] **采用 Provider-Executed Tools**：让 provider 端执行工具（如 OpenAI 内置工具），不再仅限 client-side
- [ ] **配置 Anthropic `structuredOutputMode`**：启用 Claude Sonnet 4.5+ 原生结构化输出（`'outputFormat'` / `'jsonTool'` / `'auto'`）

- [ ] **`Output.choice()` 用于分类场景**
- [ ] **Reranking API**：Voyage AI provider 已注册，可对接实验性 rerank
- [ ] **Tool Execution Approval (`needsApproval`)**

---

## 三、Provider 层已知缺陷修复

### Bug / FIXME

- [ ] **Qwen3 thinking 控制失效** (`parameterBuilder.ts:123`)：FIXME — Qwen3 即使禁用 thinking 仍会启用，不支持 `/no_think` 软开关
- [ ] **OpenRouter 推理检测逻辑重复** (`utils/reasoning.ts:399`)：FIXME — 重复的 openrouter 逻辑需合并

title: [Bug]: Historical reasoning content cross-provider contamination when switching thinking models causes API errors
body:
> [!NOTE]
> This issue was translated by Claude.

### Issue Checklist

- [x] I've confirmed that I am using the latest version of Cherry Studio.

### Platform

macOS

### Version

v2.0.0-alpha

### Bug Description

When switching between thinking/reasoning models in the same conversation, the thinking content generated by the previous model is sent as-is as ReasoningPart to the new model, causing the new model's API to error.

**Typical scenario**: Use Kimi K2.5 (with thinking) for conversation first, then switch to Claude Sonnet 4.5 (extended thinking). Claude API refuses the request because it received reasoning content with non-Claude signatures.

**Root cause**: messageConverter.ts:235-237 blindly converts all ThinkingMessageBlock to ReasoningPart without distinguishing source providers:

Different providers have incompatible thinking formats:
- **Claude**: Extended thinking has encrypted signatures and requires historical reasoning to be returned as-is with its own signature
- **Gemini**: Has thoughtSignature mechanism
- **Kimi / DeepSeek / Qwen**: Thinking is plain text without signatures
- **OpenAI o-series**: Reasoning tokens are invisible, so there's no historical passing problem

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Start a new conversation and select Kimi K2.5 model (enable thinking)
2. Send a message that requires reasoning, wait for the model to return a response with thinking content
3. Switch the model to Claude Sonnet 4.5 (enable extended thinking) in the same conversation
4. Send a new message
5. Claude API errors, refusing to include reasoning content with non-Claude signatures

Other trigger combinations: DeepSeek R1 → Claude, Qwen(thinking) → Claude, Claude → Gemini, any model → Gemini (missing thoughtSignature)

### Expected Behavior

After switching models, thinking content from other models in message history should not be sent as ReasoningPart to the current model. The conversation should continue normally, with thinking content only displayed in the UI.

### Relevant Log Output

Error: Invalid reasoning content signature

### Additional Context

## Suggested Fix

Record the source provider in ThinkingMessageBlock and filter by provider when converting.

### Step 1: Extend ThinkingMessageBlock Type

Add sourceProviderId field to track which provider generated the thinking content.

### Step 2: Record Source When Writing

Record the current provider ID when creating ThinkingMessageBlock in the streaming callback.

### Step 3: Filter by Source When Converting

Only include reasoning content from the current provider or content without a source provider ID. Cross-provider thinking is skipped and not sent to the model (still displayed in UI).

### Why Not Simply Strip All Historical Thinking

Claude extended thinking requires historical reasoning to be returned as-is (including signatures), and stripping it will cause errors or degraded reasoning quality in subsequent rounds. Therefore, precise filtering by source is necessary.

At the same time, Gemini's thoughtSignature (currently saved in MainTextBlock.metadata) should also be protected with this logic, only sent when the target provider is Google.

**Related files:**
- src/renderer/src/aiCore/prepareParams/messageConverter.ts — Core conversion logic
- src/renderer/src/types/newMessage.ts — ThinkingMessageBlock definition
- src/renderer/src/aiCore/plugins/skipGeminiThoughtSignaturePlugin.ts — Gemini signature handling
- src/renderer/src/aiCore/utils/reasoning.ts — Various provider reasoning parameters

### Platform

### Bug Description

在同一对话中切换 thinking/reasoning 模型时，前一个模型产生的 thinking 内容会被原样作为 ReasoningPart 发送给新模型，导致新模型 API 报错。

**典型场景**：先用 Kimi K2.5（带 thinking）对话，再切换到 Claude Sonnet 4.5（extended thinking），Claude API 拒绝请求，因为收到了非 Claude 签名的 reasoning 内容。

**根因**：messageConverter.ts:235-237 盲目转换所有 ThinkingMessageBlock 为 ReasoningPart，不区分来源 provider：

不同 provider 的 thinking 格式互不兼容：
- **Claude**：extended thinking 有加密签名，要求历史 reasoning 原样返回自身签名内容
- **Gemini**：有 thoughtSignature 机制
- **Kimi / DeepSeek / Qwen**：thinking 是纯文本，无签名
- **OpenAI o-series**：reasoning tokens 不可见，不存在历史传递问题

### Steps To Reproduce

1. 开启一个新对话，选择 Kimi K2.5 模型（启用 thinking）
2. 发送一条需要推理的消息，等待模型返回带 thinking 内容的响应
3. 在同一对话中切换模型为 Claude Sonnet 4.5（启用 extended thinking）
4. 发送新消息
5. Claude API 报错，拒绝包含非 Claude 签名的 reasoning 内容

其他触发组合：DeepSeek R1 → Claude、Qwen(thinking) → Claude、Claude → Gemini、任意模型 → Gemini（缺少 thoughtSignature）

### Expected Behavior

切换模型后，历史消息中来自其他模型的 thinking 内容不应作为 ReasoningPart 发送给当前模型。对话应正常继续，thinking 内容仅在 UI 中展示。

### Relevant Log Output

Error: Invalid reasoning content signature

### Additional Context

## 建议修复方案

在 ThinkingMessageBlock 中记录来源 provider，转换时按 provider 匹配过滤。

### Step 1: 扩展 ThinkingMessageBlock 类型

### Step 2: 写入时记录来源

在 streaming callback 创建 ThinkingMessageBlock 时，记录当前 provider ID。

### Step 3: 转换时按来源过滤

跨 provider 的 thinking 直接跳过，不发送给模型（UI 仍然展示）

### 为什么不能一刀切剥离所有历史 thinking

Claude extended thinking 要求历史 reasoning 原样返回（含签名），剥离会导致后续轮次报错或推理质量下降。因此必须按来源精确过滤。

同时 Gemini 的 thoughtSignature（当前保存在 MainTextBlock.metadata）也应统一用此逻辑保护，只在 target provider 为 Google 时发送。

**相关文件：**
- src/renderer/src/aiCore/prepareParams/messageConverter.ts — 核心转换逻辑
- src/renderer/src/types/newMessage.ts — ThinkingMessageBlock 定义
- src/renderer/src/aiCore/plugins/skipGeminiThoughtSignaturePlugin.ts — Gemini 签名处理
- src/renderer/src/aiCore/utils/reasoning.ts — 各 provider reasoning 参数

>

**Foundry API 格式差异：**
```
# Azure OpenAI (当前支持)
https://{resource}.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/{model}/chat/completions?api-version=xxx

# Azure AI Foundry - 统一推理端点 (不支持)
https://{resource}.services.ai.azure.com/models/chat/completions

# Azure AI Foundry - OpenAI-compatible (不支持)
https://{endpoint}/v1/chat/completions
```

**需要支持：**
1. 统一推理端点 — 一个 endpoint 访问多个模型
2. Serverless API — per-model endpoint
3. Azure Claude / DeepSeek — 原生支持而非 workaround
4. 认证 — API Key + Azure AD token

title: [Feature]: Track Vercel AI SDK v7 features and migration plan for Cherry Studio v2
body:
### Issue Checklist

- [x] I understand that issues are for reporting problems and requesting features, not for off-topic comments, and I will provide as much detail as possible to help resolve the issue.
- [x] I have checked the pinned issues and searched through the existing open issues, closed issues, and discussions and did not find a similar suggestion.
- [x] I have provided a short and descriptive title so that developers can quickly understand the issue when browsing the issue list, rather than vague titles like "A suggestion" or "Stuck."
- [x] The latest version of Cherry Studio does not include the feature I am suggesting.

### Platform

macOS

### Version

v2 (development branch)

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

Cherry Studio 当前使用 `ai@^6.0.143` 和 17 个 `@ai-sdk/*` provider 包。Vercel AI SDK v7 已进入 beta 阶段，多项架构级改进正快速推进。本 issue 追踪 v7 新特性及其对 Cherry Studio v2 的影响。

**Tracking issue**: [vercel/ai#14011](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/14011)
**Milestone**: [v7.0](https://github.com/vercel/ai/milestone/5) — **55% complete (44/79 closed)** ⬆ 较上次跟踪大幅推进

### Desired Solution

## v7 新特性梳理及状态

> 状态说明: ✅ 已合并进主线 | 🚧 开发中/未合并 | ❌ 已关闭(未合并)
> 最近更新: 2026-04-17（milestone 从 28% → 55%）

---

## 🆕 近期重大进展（2026-04-05 ~ 04-17）

### A. WorkflowAgent 正式发布 ✅ 已合并
- [vercel/ai#12165](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/12165) — MERGED (2026-04-13)
- 新包 **`@ai-sdk/workflow`** 作为 [DurableAgent](https://useworkflow.dev/docs/api-reference/workflow-ai/durable-agent) 继任者
- **与 ToolLoopAgent API 对齐完成**: [vercel/ai#14451](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/14451)
  - 统一 callback 签名: [#14456](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/14456)
  - callback event 形状对齐: [#14454](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/14454)
  - prompt 参数、id、stream-only defaults 对齐
- **Cherry 影响**: 桌面应用直接价值有限，但 `Agent` 接口的统一意味着后续实现自定义 Agent 时有稳定参考

### B. Context API 稳定化 ✅ 已合并
- [vercel/ai#14325](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/14325) — CLOSED (2026-04-10)
- `experimental_context` → `context`（移除 experimental 前缀）
- 类型从 `unknown` 改为泛型，支持更好的类型推断
- **Cherry 影响**: 在我们 `(C, G)` 形式化框架下，这直接对应 `C` 的稳定接口——Cherry Runtime 可以基于稳定的 context API 设计

### C. CallSettings 拆分 ✅ 已合并 ⚠️ BREAKING
- [vercel/ai#14417](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/14417) — MERGED (2026-04-13)
- `CallSettings` 拆分为两个类型:
  - **`ModelCallOptions`**: 模型面生成控制 (`temperature`, `topP`, `reasoning`, ...)
  - **`RequestOptions`**: 请求面传输控制 (`maxRetries`, `abortSignal`, `timeout`, ...)
- **Cherry 影响**: `packages/aiCore/src/core/runtime/types.ts` 中的参数类型需要拆分重构

### D. Timeout 完整方案 ✅ 已完成
- [vercel/ai#14306](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/14306) — CLOSED (2026-04-09)
- 完整的分层超时配置: `totalMs` / `stepMs` / `chunkMs` / `toolMs` / 每工具 `{toolName}Ms`
- **Cherry 影响**: 可直接使用，完全替代 Cherry 现有的超时管理（如果有）

### E. Top-Level Reasoning 完全完成 ✅
- [vercel/ai#14307](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/14307) — CLOSED (2026-04-09)
- 顶层 `reasoning` 参数在 `generateText`/`streamText` 中可用
- 支持 `reasoning-file` 等非文本 reasoning part

### F. Telemetry 稳定化 ✅ 已合并
- [vercel/ai#7405](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/7405) — CLOSED (2026-04-10)
- telemetry 测试示例合并，API 进入稳定阶段

### G. CJS Exports 正式移除 ✅ 已合并
- [vercel/ai#9681](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/9681) — CLOSED (2026-04-13)
- v7 官方正式纯 ESM

### H. image-* → file-* 类型统一 ✅ 已合并 ⚠️ BREAKING
- [vercel/ai#14411](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/14411) — CLOSED (2026-04-13)
- 工具输出的 `image-*` 类型合并进 `file-*` 类型
- **Cherry 影响**: 涉及图像工具结果的代码需要更新类型

### I. Migration Guide 开始完善 ✅
- [vercel/ai#14149](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/14149) — CLOSED (2026-04-06)
- 为 #12516, #12995, #13321, #13971 添加了迁移指南starter


### J. 🔥 Tool Approval 一级 API ✅ 已合并 (NEW!)
- [vercel/ai#14480](https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/14480) — MERGED (2026-04-16)
- 新增 `toolNeedsApproval` 选项到 `generateText` / `streamText` / `ToolLoopAgent`
- 可以覆盖工具自身的 `needsApproval` 设置（对第三方/MCP 工具尤其重要）
- 支持布尔值或 approval 函数
- **Cherry 影响**: 这直接对应我们 `(C, G)` 形式化中的 `G`（安全门控）。Cherry 可用 SDK 原生 approval 机制替代 `src/renderer/src/utils/userConfirmation.ts` 的自建系统
- 示例:
  ```typescript
  const agent = new ToolLoopAgent({
    tools: { weather, writeFile, bash },
    toolNeedsApproval: {
      weather: false,       // 显式不需要批准
      writeFile: true,      // 显式需要批准
      bash: async (args) => isRisky(args.command),  // 动态判定
    },
  })
  ```

### K. 🔥 toolsContext 与 runtimeContext 分离 ✅ 已合并 (NEW!)
- [vercel/ai#14515](https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/14515) — MERGED (2026-04-16)
- [vercel/ai#14536](https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/14536) — `context` 重命名为 `runtimeContext`
- **安全驱动的改动**: 防止恶意第三方工具访问其他工具的 context
- 每个工具只能访问显式为它提供的 `toolsContext`
- 支持 `contextSchema` (Zod) 做类型验证
- **Cherry 影响**:
  - ⚠️ BREAKING: `context` → `runtimeContext` 重命名，Cherry 需要跟进
  - ✅ 安全模型对齐：Cherry 如果引入用户自定义 MCP，此机制天然提供隔离
- 示例:
  ```typescript
  const weather = tool({
    inputSchema: z.object({ location: z.string() }),
    contextSchema: z.object({ apiKey: z.string() }),
    execute: async ({ location }, { context: { apiKey } }) => { /* ... */ },
  })

  await generateText({
    tools: { weather },
    toolsContext: {
      weather: { apiKey: process.env.WEATHER_KEY },
    },
  })
  ```

### L. Telemetry 默认开启 ✅ 已合并 (NEW!)
- [vercel/ai#14500](https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/14500) — MERGED (2026-04-16)

- [vercel/ai#14503](https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/14503) — `TelemetrySettings` 重命名为 `TelemetryOptions`
- **Cherry 影响**:
  - 升级后默认会产生 telemetry span — 需确认 `mcp-trace` 管道能正确处理
  - 如不希望默认收集，需显式关闭
  - 类型重命名: Cherry 中使用 `TelemetrySettings` 的地方需更新

### M. 移除 deprecated experimental 选项 ✅ 已合并 ⚠️ BREAKING
- [vercel/ai#14548](https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/14548) — 移除 `experimental_prepareStep`（v5 已 deprecated）
- [vercel/ai#14483](https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/14483) — 移除 `experimental_activeTools`（v5 已 deprecated）
- **Cherry 影响**: 搜索替换性工作，用稳定版本 `prepareStep` / `activeTools`

### N. Anthropic Opus 4.7 支持 ✅ 已合并 (NEW!)
- [vercel/ai#14529](https://github.com/vercel/ai/pull/14529) — MERGED (2026-04-16)
- 新模型: `claude-opus-4-7`
- API 行为变化:
  - Sampling 参数 (`temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`) deprecated — 非默认值会 400
  - 新的 `xhigh` effort level
  - **Task Budgets**: agentic workflow 的 token 预算建议机制
  - **`thinking.display` API**: 控制 thinking 内容是否返回（默认不返回！）
- **Cherry 影响**:
  - 添加 Opus 4.7 到模型列表
  - Cherry 当前默认显示 thinking — 需要为 4.7 显式设置 `thinking.display`
  - Task Budgets 可用作 Cherry runtime 的 context 压缩触发信号

## 升级方案

### Phase 0: 评估与准备（现在 → v7 RC）

**目标**: 降低风险，确保 v2 数据层设计与 v7 方向对齐

- [ ] **Patch 审计**: 评估 `@ai-sdk/openai-compatible@2.0.37`, `@ai-sdk/google@3.0.55` 两个 patch 在 V4 provider spec 下是否仍需
- [ ] **ModelMessage 持久化设计**: v2 SQLite schema 以 ModelMessage 为存储标准
- [ ] **CallSettings 拆分适配**: 更新 `packages/aiCore/src/core/runtime/types.ts` 以适配 `ModelCallOptions` + `RequestOptions` 拆分
- [ ] **Reasoning 统一评估**: 梳理 provider-specific reasoning 处理，计划迁移到顶层 `reasoning` 参数
- [ ] **CJS 兼容验证**: 确认 Cherry main process 在纯 ESM 环境下无问题
- [ ] **Compaction 方案对齐**: 评估 Cherry `COMPACT` MessageBlock 与 `CompactionFunction` 的对接
- [ ] **file-* 类型迁移**: 评估工具输出中 `image-*` 到 `file-*` 的改造点

### Phase 1: 低风险特性先行采用（v7 beta 稳定后）

**目标**: 采用已合并且 API 稳定的特性，获得即时收益

- [ ] **Timeout 完整方案** (✅ 已完成): 全局 `totalMs`/`stepMs`/`chunkMs` + 工具级 `toolMs` + 每工具配置
- [ ] **Top-Level Reasoning** (✅ 已完成): 移除 `packages/aiCore/src/core/options/factory.ts` 中 provider-specific reasoning，统一使用顶层 API
- [ ] **Deferred Tool Execution** (✅ 已合并): 改善 tool 审批 UX
- [ ] **Remote File APIs** (✅ 已合并): 统一文件上传逻辑
- [ ] **Stable Context** (✅ 已完成): 利用稳定 `context` API + 类型推断改进类型安全
- [ ] **Stable Telemetry** (✅ 已完成): `AiSdkSpanAdapter` 对接稳定 API

### Phase 2: 架构级改造（v7 stable 发布后）

**目标**: 采用需要架构调整的特性

- [ ] **External Loop Control**: 待 [#13570](https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/13570) 完成后，重构 `PluginEngine`
- [ ] **Compaction**: 接入 SDK `compact()` API，实现 Cherry 的多模型 `CompactionFunction`
- [ ] **Provider 全量升级**: 升级全部 17 个 `@ai-sdk/*` 包到 V4 spec 版本
- [ ] **统一 Runtime 设计**: 基于 `(C, G)` 形式化模型，构建 Cherry Agent Runtime（见 `.context/cherry-agent-runtime-design.md`）

### Phase 3: 长期跟踪

- [ ] **Realtime APIs**: 如果 Cherry 支持语音对话
- [ ] **Async/Webhook**: 如果 Cherry 支持远程 agent 执行
- [ ] **WorkflowAgent**: 评估是否对 Cherry 的远程 agent 场景有价值

### Alternative Solutions

**升级风险评估:**

| 风险 | 级别 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| Provider patches 失效 | 🔴 高 | 2 个 patch 可能需要重写 |
| `CallSettings` 拆分 | 🟡 中 | 类型重构，影响范围广但机械性强 |
| CJS 移除 | 🟡 中 | Cherry 以 ESM 为主，需验证 main process |
| `image-*` → `file-*` 类型迁移 | 🟡 中 | 图像工具结果处理需更新 |
| `experimental_context` → `context` | 🟢 低 | 简单搜索替换 |
| Node 20 drop | 🟢 低 | Cherry 已要求 Node ≥ 22 |
| ModelMessage 格式变更 | 🟡 中 | v2 数据层迁移需考虑新格式 |
| PluginEngine 重构 | 🟡 中 | External Loop Control 需要调整 aiCore |
| `stepCountIs` → `isStepCount` | 🟢 低 | 简单搜索替换 |

body:
> [!NOTE]
> This issue was translated by Claude.

### Issue Checklist

- [x] I have checked the pinned issues and searched through the existing [open issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues), [closed issues](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20state%3Aclosed), and [discussions](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/discussions) and did not find a similar suggestion.

### Platform

Windows

1.8.4

### Is your feature request related to an existing issue?

**Core Requirements:**
- I already have many scattered folders on my computer (don't want to copy files, don't want duplicates, don't want to manually move them to specific directories).
- I want seamless local RAG: directly monitor existing folders, automatic indexing/incremental updates, similar to everything's file monitoring and search.
- Support multiple formats (PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, even images, video, audio), the closer to NotebookLM the better.
- Coordinate with claudecode/cherrystudio/Ollama (both CLI or API can easily integrate with other clients).
- Obsidian can only manage MD files, too limited.

CherryStudio (and many similar tools, including early AnythingLLM's default approach) does require you to copy/move files into a dedicated knowledge base folder before RAG processing. This leads to:
- Duplicate files (original file + copy within the tool)
- Manual sync or re-upload required after modifications
- Particularly troublesome when files are scattered across the computer

The "seamless RAG" you want—directly indexing existing folders on your computer in-place, without copying or moving, automatically monitoring changes, incremental updates—is the ideal solution. Several tools are already moving in this direction and getting closer.

**Truly "seamless local RAG" recommended solutions:**

1. **Most recommended: local-rag** (currently matches your description best)
   GitHub: https://github.com/OpenMined/local-rag
   **Key highlights:**
   - Directly select any existing folder on your computer (including subfolders) through a beautiful file browser.
   - Automatic file watching: automatically incremental indexing when files are added, modified, or deleted.
   - Uses content hashes to determine if files have changed, only processes modified files, won't re-embed.
   - Only stores vectors + metadata (pointing to original file paths), doesn't copy original files.
   - Web interface operation, suitable for non-developers.
   - This is basically what you call "seamless RAG".

2. **RLAMA** (minimal command line, suitable for Ollama users)
   - Supports \`rlama watch my-knowledge-base ./existing-folder 60\` (check every 60 seconds, or set to 0 to check when querying).
   - Directly monitor your existing folders, new files automatically enter RAG.

3. **Obsidian solution** (if you have large amounts of Markdown/notes)
   - If your materials are mostly .md files, or you're willing to convert important documents to Markdown,
   - Use Obsidian to open your existing folder as a Vault → Install Copilot or Vault QA plugin → One-click index the entire Vault.
   - Automatic re-indexing when adding/modifying notes, completely zero-copy, zero-move.

4. **DocMason and CherryStudio's current status**
   - **CherryStudio**: Currently still requires adding files to its Knowledge Base, basically produces copies (or at least stores a processed copy).
   - **DocMason** (repo-native): The concept is close (treating the repository/folder itself as an App), but currently more focused on "code repository + complex office files" analyst scenarios, whether it supports complete folder monitoring + zero-copy is still in early stages. If you mainly have code/project folders, you can try it; if it's scattered various documents, local-rag is more direct.

### Desired Solution

"Seamless local RAG"—directly indexing existing folders on your computer in-place, without copying or moving, automatically monitoring changes, incremental updates, coordinating with claudecode—is the ideal solution.

Obsidian 只能管 MD 文件，太局限了。


CherryStudio（以及很多类似工具，包括早期 AnythingLLM 的默认方式）确实要求你把文件复制/移动到一个专属的知识库文件夹里，然后再 RAG 化。这会导致：
文件双份（原文件 + 工具内一份）
修改后要手动同步或重新上传
文件散落在电脑各处时特别麻烦

你想要的"无感 RAG 化"——直接对电脑上已有的文件夹原地索引、不复制、不移动、自动监控变化、增量更新——才是最理想的方案。目前已经有几款工具正在往这个方向做，而且越来越接近了。
真正接近"无感原地 RAG"的推荐方案

1. 最推荐：local-rag（目前最符合你描述）
GitHub：https://github.com/OpenMined/local-rag
核心亮点：
通过漂亮的文件浏览器直接选中你电脑上已有的任意文件夹（包括子文件夹）。
自动文件监控（Auto File Watching）：文件夹里新增、修改、删除文件时自动增量索引。
用内容哈希判断文件是否变化，只处理有改动的文件，不会重复嵌入。
只存向量 + 元数据（指向原始文件路径），不复制原始文件。
Web 界面操作，适合非开发者。
这基本就是你说的"无感 RAG 化"。

支持 rlama watch 我的知识库 ./已有文件夹 60（每 60 秒检查一次，或设为 0 在查询时检查）。
直接监控你现有的文件夹，新增文件自动进入 RAG。

3. Obsidian 方案（如果你有大量 Markdown/笔记）
如果你的资料很多是 .md 文件，或者你愿意把重要文档转成 Markdown，
直接用 Obsidian 打开你现有的文件夹作为 Vault → 安装 Copilot 或 Vault QA 插件 → 一键索引整个 Vault。
新增/修改笔记时自动重新索引，完全零复制、零移动。

4. DocMason 和 CherryStudio 的现状
CherryStudio：目前还是需要把文件添加到它的 Knowledge Base，基本会产生副本（或至少存一份处理后的数据）。
DocMason（repo-native）：理念很接近（把仓库/文件夹本身当 App），但目前更偏向"代码仓库 + 复杂办公文件"的分析师场景，是否支持完整文件夹监控 + 零复制还在早期阶段。如果你主要是代码/项目文件夹，可以试试；如果是散落的各种文档，local-rag 更直接。

title: [Refactor]: Improve error handling in IPC handlers (silent failures)
body:
## Context

Found during review of #14052 (IPC modularization). These are **pre-existing issues** carried over from the original `src/main/ipc.ts` and `src/preload/index.ts`, not regressions.

## Issues

### 1. `App_GetSystemFonts` silently returns `[]` on failure
- **File**: [`src/main/ipc.ts:201-209`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/main/ipc.ts#L201-L209)
- Catch block logs the error but returns `[]`, indistinguishable from a system with zero fonts.

### 2. `App_GetCacheSize` returns `"0"` on failure
- **File**: [`src/main/ipc.ts:257-269`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/main/ipc.ts#L257-L269)
- Returns `"0"` on error, indistinguishable from an empty cache. Could mask permission issues.

### 3. `App_Select` returns `null` on both cancellation and error
- **File**: [`src/main/ipc.ts:272-283`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/main/ipc.ts#L272-L283)
- User cancellation and dialog crash both return `null`. Renderer cannot distinguish the two cases.

### 4. `App_GetDiskInfo` returns `null` on failure
- **File**: [`src/main/ipc.ts:653-665`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/main/ipc.ts#L653-L665)
- No way for renderer to know *why* disk info is unavailable.

### 5. `WeChat_HasCredentials` has empty catch block
- **File**: [`src/main/ipc.ts:783-792`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/main/ipc.ts#L783-L792)
- Catches **all** error types (JSON parse errors, permission errors, I/O failures) and silently returns `{ exists: false }` with no logging.

### 6. `contextBridge` catch block uses `console.error` instead of `loggerService`
- **File**: [`src/preload/index.ts:952-959`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/preload/index.ts#L952-L959)
- Violates project logging standard. If `contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld` fails, the entire renderer API surface will be undefined, but the error only goes to console and is not captured by Winston/Sentry.
- The catch block should re-throw or crash the app since a failed API exposure means the application is non-functional.

### 7. `onFileChange` silently drops non-object events
- **File**: [`src/preload/index.ts:275-282`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/preload/index.ts#L275-L282)
- Guard `if (data && typeof data === 'object')` silently discards non-object payloads with no logging. If the main process sends malformed file change events, the renderer will silently stop receiving file updates.

## Suggested approach

Consider returning structured error results (e.g., `{ success: false, error: string }`) or at minimum ensure all catch blocks have logging.

## Context

Found during review of #14052 (IPC modularization). These are **pre-existing issues** carried over from the original `src/preload/index.ts`, not regressions.

## Issues

### 1. Duplicate API calling the same IPC channel
- **File**: [`src/preload/index.ts:189-190`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/preload/index.ts#L189-L190) and [`src/preload/index.ts:203-204`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/preload/index.ts#L203-L204)
- `checkConnection` and `checkWebdavConnection` both invoke `IpcChannel.Backup_CheckConnection` with identical parameters
- One should be removed

### 2. Inconsistent `off()` vs `removeListener()` usage
- `ipcRenderer.off()`: used at lines 281, 464, 519, 550, 630, 642, 662, 692, 711, 723, 822, 845, 855
- `ipcRenderer.removeListener()`: used at lines 809, 869, 903, 911
- Even within the same logical section, both styles appear
- Should be unified to `ipcRenderer.off()` throughout

### 3. Hardcoded channel strings bypass `IpcChannel` enum
- [`src/preload/index.ts:385`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/preload/index.ts#L385) → `selection-menu:action`
- [`src/preload/index.ts:280`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/preload/index.ts#L280) → `file-change`
- [`src/preload/index.ts:517`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/preload/index.ts#L517) → `protocol-data`
- These should use `IpcChannel` constants to prevent silent breakage

### 4. Repeated listener subscription boilerplate (~15 occurrences)
- Every `on*` subscription follows identical pattern:
```typescript
const listener = (_event: Electron.IpcRendererEvent, data: T) => {
  callback(data)
}
ipcRenderer.on(channel, listener)
return () => ipcRenderer.off(channel, listener)
```
- A shared helper could eliminate this repetition

### 5. `shell.openExternal` catch block lacks security audit logging
- **File**: [`src/preload/index.ts:472-483`](https://github.com/CherryHQ/cherry-studio/blob/v2/src/preload/index.ts#L472-L483)
- Blocked URL attempts at the preload defense-in-depth layer are not logged
- The main-process `Open_Website` handler logs blocked URLs, but the preload layer does not

## Priority

Low — these are consistency and maintainability improvements.

## Parent Issue

Part of #14018 — **P0: Audio/Video Files as LLM Input**

## Summary

`fileProcessor.ts` needs to support audio file input, converting formats such as `.mp3/.wav/.ogg/.flac/.aac` to `AudioPart`/`FilePart` to send to the model.

Gemini 2.0, GPT-4o, and other models already support audio understanding capabilities. The audio file processing pipeline needs to be implemented at the file processor layer.

## Desired Solution

- Add audio file processing logic in `fileProcessor.ts`
- Supported formats: `.mp3`, `.wav`, `.ogg`, `.flac`, `.aac`
- Convert audio files to AI SDK's `AudioPart` or `FilePart`
- Send to models that support audio understanding (Gemini 2.0, GPT-4o, etc.)

## Alternative Solutions

- Consider using Web Audio API for format conversion on the renderer side first, then send to supported models

## Additional Context

**Existing Infrastructure:**
- Audio streaming Chunk types already defined: `AudioStartChunk`, `AudioDeltaChunk`, `AudioCompleteChunk`
- Voice error types already defined: `SerializedAiSdkNoSpeechGeneratedError`

**Current AI SDK Version:** `ai@^6.0.143`

title: feat: compress large images before sending to LLM API
body:
## Background

From #14057 investigation: a user reported "empty payload" and "infinite loading" when sending multiple images to Gemini 3 Flash. Root cause was that the user's images were ~15MB each (4 images = 60MB+ base64 payload), causing extremely slow upload times and Chrome DevTools unable to display the request body.

## Proposal

Compress large images before base64-encoding them for the LLM API payload. Most LLM vision APIs work well with images at 1-2MP resolution; sending raw 15MB screenshots/photos is wasteful.

## Possible approach

- Add a configurable size threshold (e.g., >1MB or >2048px on longest side)
- Use `sharp` (already a dependency) to resize/compress in the main process
- Apply compression at the `base64Image` level or in the message converter
- Preserve original files — only compress the copy sent to the API

Related to #14057. A user reported "infinite loading" when sending multiple images to Gemini 3 Flash. Investigation revealed the user's images were ~15MB each (4 images), resulting in a 60MB+ base64 payload. The upload was simply taking too long due to the massive request size.

Currently, images are sent at their original resolution and file size. For most LLM vision APIs, images beyond 2048px or 1-2MB provide no additional quality benefit but significantly increase upload time and API costs.

### Desired Solution

Add automatic image compression before sending images to the LLM API:

- Set a configurable threshold (e.g., images >1MB or >2048px on longest side)
- Use `sharp` (already a project dependency) to resize and compress in the main process
- Apply compression at the `base64Image` / `binaryImage` level so all downstream consumers benefit

- Let users manually resize images before pasting (poor UX)
- Add a file size warning when images exceed a threshold (helps awareness but doesn't solve the problem)

### Additional Information

Most LLM providers recommend or enforce image size limits:
- Gemini: max 20MB per request
- Claude: max 5MB per image
- OpenAI: auto-resizes to 2048px
